cases.description: An absent event capacity materializes the schema default, not the SDK's own
An absent polling endpoint materializes app.launchdarkly.com
An absent gzip setting materializes false, matching Go rather than Rust
An absent start wait materializes 5000, matching Java rather than .NET
An absent socket timeout materializes 10000, taken from Java because Go has none
An explicit value overrides the schema default
The default data system is a polling initializer with streaming then polling synchronizers
